title: Nuevo Laredo brings city services and health care to Colonia Nueva Victoria today
excerpt: Nuevo Laredo's 'Presidencia Cerquita de Ti' program visits Colonia Nueva Victoria today, Thursday, November 5, from 9 a.m. to 2 p.m., with municipal services, health care, and food support in one place.
content:
Families in Colonia Nueva Victoria can take care of city business and health care without leaving their neighborhood today.

The Nuevo Laredo municipal government is bringing a new edition of its “Presidencia Cerquita de Ti” program to Colonia Nueva Victoria on Thursday, November 5, from 9:00 a.m. to 2:00 p.m., at the Plaza y Centro Comunitario on calle Rea, between Artículo 25 and avenida Triunfo, according to local reports.

During the event, residents can handle municipal procedures, pay the property tax, get legal advice, learn about social programs, and receive food support, all in one place.

Health services will include general medicine, nutrition, psychology, and comprehensive care for women, along with glucose, blood pressure, and glycated hemoglobin screenings, vaccinations, and rapid tests for HIV, VDRL, and hepatitis.

The DIF system, the Civil Registry, the State Fiscal Office, and the College of Notaries are also taking part, according to the reports.

The program, promoted by the administration of Mayor Carmen Lilia Canturosas Villarreal, aims to bring municipal offices and other institutions closer to residents in Nuevo Laredo's colonias.

Sources: CML Noticias and Desde Donde Estamos, reporting on the “Presidencia Cerquita de Ti” visit to Colonia Nueva Victoria on November 4-5, 2026.
